camel_example: aliyun polardb CreateKBSyncLink --region cn-hangzhou --LinkName testName --SourceDir 'https://example.feishu.cn/wiki/space/xxxxxx' --ClientSecret 'example-client-secret' --SourceType FEISHU --KnowledgeBaseId 'pkb-xxxxx' --ClientId cli_xxxxxxbe8 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Creates a knowledge base synchronization link
kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-kb-sync-link --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --knowledge-base-id pkb-xxxxx --link-name testName --source-type FEISHU --client-id cli_xxxxxxbe8 --client-secret example-client-secret --source-dir https://example.feishu.cn/wiki/space/xxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateKBSyncLink

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the synchronization link
parameters.name: link_name

parameters.help_en: The data source type. Valid values: OSS, DINGTALK, FEISHU, and SHAREPOINT
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source tenant. This parameter is required and must be set to the Entra tenant ID when SourceType is set to SHAREPOINT, the tenant_key when SourceType is set to FEISHU, or the corpId when SourceType is set to DINGTALK. This parameter is not required when SourceType is set to OSS
parameters.help_zh: 来源租户 ID。SourceType=SHAREPOINT 时必填 Entra tenant ID；FEISHU 时必填 tenant_key；DINGTALK 时必填 corpId；OSS 时无需填写
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DingTalk user that performs the operation
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the successful snapshot of Lark chat members for fallback reuse, in seconds. This parameter can be explicitly set only for Lark synchronization links. A value of -1 indicates that the snapshot never expires. A value of 0 indicates that snapshot fallback reuse is disabled. A positive integer indicates the maximum age of the snapshot allowed for reuse. Default value: -1. If this parameter is not specified, the default value -1 is used
parameters.help_zh: 飞书群成员成功快照用于降级复用的有效期，单位为秒。仅 FEISHU 同步链路可显式设置；-1 表示永不过期，0 表示禁用快照降级复用，正整数表示允许复用的快照最大年龄；默认值为 -1，省略时按 -1 生效
parameters.name: feishu_chat_member_stale_ttl_seconds

parameters.help_en: The Lark user access token. This token is used only when the application identity cannot expand chat members because the bot is not in the chat
parameters.help_zh: 飞书用户访问令牌，仅在应用身份因机器人不在群聊而无法展开群成员时使用
parameters.name: user_access_token

parameters.help_en: The Lark user refresh token. This token must be provided together with UserAccessToken and is used to automatically rotate the fallback identity for expanding chat members
parameters.help_zh: 飞书用户刷新令牌，须与 UserAccessToken 一起提供，用于自动轮转群成员展开回退身份
parameters.name: user_refresh_token

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the DingTalk document MCP server
parameters.help_zh: 钉钉文档 MCP Server 地址
parameters.name: mcp_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the DingTalk sheet MCP server
parameters.help_zh: 钉钉表格 MCP Server 地址
parameters.name: sheet_mcp_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The address of the source directory for synchronization
parameters.name: source_dir

parameters.help_en: The description of the synchronization link
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_zh: 同步时间间隔，单位：分钟
parameters.name: sync_interval_minutes
